passages.provision_quote: Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex.
passages.note: The bill reserves girls'/women's teams for the female sex while leaving male and coed teams unrestricted, matching rung 4 and excluding a full ban.
Bill overview confirms House Third Reading final passage of this single-subject bill 31-24-5-0-0; Carter is not listed among the sponsors.
House Third Reading roll call shows Carter voting Y on this single-subject bill.

rows.reasoning: Carter voted Y in the House Third Reading of SB 1165 (2022) ("CARTER Y", "Passed 31-24-5-0-0"), a single-subject bill whose operative section provides that teams designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex while leaving male and coed teams unrestricted. This matches the rung that athletes must "compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth" and excludes the full-ban rung, since the bill expressly preserves eligibility on male and coed teams.
